brief.brief: Instrumental game exploration theme for Wildshard, a world that arrives one chunk at a time: wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. No vocals. 60-90 s, loopable (it will be trimmed to a bar-exact loop). The model composes freely - no required motif.
brief.title: Folk-adventure
brief.ace_caption: Folk-adventure exploration theme for a seafaring video game in the style of Sea of Thieves. A lively fiddle carries the melody over strummed and fingerpicked acoustic guitar, a warm marimba ostinato, hand percussion (frame drum, bodhran, shaker), upright bass and a touch of tin whistle and accordion. Mood: wonder first, adventure second, a little melancholy underneath - sailing towards an island that forms as you approach. Natural room sound. Instrumental, no vocals. D major with a Mixolydian flat seventh.
